header_sentences: See Divine Spiritual, Second Heaven, Spiritual Church, Spiritual Kingdom, Spiritual World, etc.
See Ancient Church, Celestial, Internal man, Israel, Lungs, Mind, Natural, People, Silver, Sheep, Water, and Wine.
Footnote:  For the difference between the Spiritual and the Celestial, and many other important passages relating to what is spiritual, see Celestial, from beginning to end.

contexts.text: He now becomes a spiritual man, who is called an image. His spiritual life is delighted with... AC 48:end. AC 51.
By the Assyrian is signified the spiritual man.
In this chapter it treats of the spiritual man...
So long as man is spiritual, his dominion proceeds from the external man to the internal. Signified.
Love, in the spiritual man, follows.
In the spiritual man they called the understanding the male, and the will, the female.
By man is here meant the spiritual man, who is called also Israel.
When man is spiritual, as while he is becoming spiritual, he is in combat. Signified. AC 59.
The spiritual man is delighted with spiritual meats. Signified. AC 57.
All those things are called spiritual which belong to the Knowledges of faith... thus to the understanding.
The spiritual man acknowledges spiritual and celestial truth and good, but from faith, from which he acts, and not so much from love.
The ends of the spiritual man regard eternal life, and so the Lord.
The spiritual man is in combat, but always conquers. The bonds which act upon him are internal, and are called the bonds of conscience.
That the man has now become spiritual, insomuch that he is the sixth day. Signified.
Reformation, in the spiritual man, begins from the external man. Signified.
Such is the order of life with the spiritual man...
Thus the order which has been inverted in the spiritual man is restored in the celestial.
The spiritual man has no perception, but conscience.
With the spiritual luau the proprium appears similar...
At last they became spiritual men. Treated of.
The spiritual are they who have received charity from the Lord though the Knowledges of faith...
The spiritual man of the sixth day. Signified.
The likeness (of this Seth) was to the spiritual man of the sixth day, which is, that love was not so much the principal thing, but still faith was conjoined with love.
Thus is it with the regeneration of the spiritual man...
The spiritual or intellectual man.
Thus a spiritual man is not one who believes faith without charity to be saving; but is one who makes charity the essential of faith, and acts from it.
The spiritual man cannot have such communication (with Heaven) as the celestial man, because the Lord is in love, and not so much in faith, Signified.
Waters = what is spiritual, that is, intellectual, rational, and scientific.
How the regeneration of the spiritual man is effected. Fully explained.
Voluntary and intellectual things are not united with the spiritual man... All the good of charity he does is of the Lord alone, not through his will, but through conscience...
It is similar with the truth which the spiritual man thinks and speaks...
Thus the regeneration of the spiritual man is the separation of his intellectual part from the voluntary through conscience... AC 895.
The Spiritual is truth...
The new life which the regenerate spiritual man receives...
The new Voluntary which the regenerate spiritual man receives... is charity.
See Celestial. AC 1005.
(Thus) every regenerate spiritual man, from love or charity, which is from the Lord alone, is His image.
Noah and his sons = the regenerate spiritual man. AC 1036:end.
The state of the regenerate spiritual man is like the rainbow. Explained.
In the regenerate spiritual man there is an intellectual proprium, into which the Lord insinuates innocence, charity, and mercy... AC 1043, Explained.
That the cloud = the obscure light in which is the spiritual man relatively to the celestial. Explained. (Continued. See Celestial.)
These two parts in the spiritual man are opposite.
Isaac = the spiritual man. AC 1409:3.
Intellectual, rational, and scientific things are called man's spiritual things; and they are in this order. Explained. AC 1866:2. AC 2504:end.
These things involve arcana... concerning man's instruction and regeneration, that he may become spiritual, (and also celestial).
Spiritual things correspond to those who are spiritual.
This is evident with the regenerate spiritual man...
Wine = spiritual things and recreation thence.
See Speak.
Turtle-dove, and young pigeon = the Spiritual things of the Church. AC 1826. AC 1830.
Birds = spiritual things. AC 1826. AC 1832.
Spiritual things mean all things of faith, consequently all doctrinal things... Between these and the Lord there is no parallelism and correspondence. Signified, Explained.
This intellectual truth (Sarai) is the Spiritual itself which inflows through... an internal way...
The affection of truth is predicated of the spiritual man...
Bought with silver = the spiritual, thus those within the Church. AC 2101. AC 2114.
Those are called the spiritual who are in love towards the neighbour, and thus in the truth of faith. Such was the Ancient Church.
The spiritual are like the lungs.
The Lord appears to the spiritual as a Moon. (See Moon.)
The spiritual are characterized by charity, and are here signified by Ishmael. AC 2088.
Those who are rational from truth, or the spiritual. Treated of.

(At first all were celestial) but afterwards, when love to the Lord was no longer so great, the spiritual succeeded; and they were called spiritual men when they were in love towards the neighbour. Explained.
The spiritual, through the truths which appear to them as truths, receive from the Lord charity, and, through this, conscience.
Grapes, and whatever is from them, = what is spiritual.
How man comes into a spiritual idea.

Thoughts from conscience are lower, and exist with the spiritual; that is, with those who are in the good of charity and of faith as to life and as to doctrine. To think contrary to conscience is to them impossible...
God is mentioned when spiritual things are treated of.
(Good makes man spiritual; not truths alone.)
The Lord came to save the spiritual... AC 2716.
The spiritual also are seed; but from the son of the handmaid.
Other sheep = the spiritual.
Water = the Spiritual, or truth.
The first state of those who become spiritual. Signified. AC 2678, Explained.
With those who become spiritual, good and truth are implanted by the Lord in the affection of knowledges. Signified, Explained.

The first state of those who become spiritual is that they suppose they think truth and do good from themselves... and when told that all good and truth are from the Lord, they do not reject it, but do not acknowledge it at heart, because they do not sensibly feel it...
A bow is predicated of the spiritual man. AC 2686:2, Explained.
The state of the desolation of truth... with those who become spiritual. Signified, Explained.
Who can become spiritual, and who cannot. Explained.
Man's Spiritual is born from the affection of the Knowledges of truth from doctrine.
The presence of the Lord with the spiritual. Signified, Explained.
The Spiritual does not exist without a subject.
The state of the spiritual compared with that of the celestial. (Fully quoted under Celestial, and at AC 2715.)
The life of the spiritual man as to good. Signified, Explained.
That the good of the spiritual man is relatively obscure; and that this obscurity is illuminated by the Lord's Divine Human. Signified, Explained. AC 2716. Explained.

For the spiritual man does not know what is true from any perception... but from instruction... and doctrine... and when he adds anything from himself, the Sensuous and its fallacies, and the Rational and its appearances, for the most part prevail, and cause him to be scarcely able to acknowledge any pure truth... Still, in these seeming truths the Lord implants good... but the good becomes obscure from them.
(Thus) the spiritual man does not know what evil is...
(Thus) the spiritual man... does not know that good is the essential of faith...
Still, the spiritual can come from obscurity into light, provided...
Loathing felt when what is spiritual and celestial is mentioned.
The Salvation of the spiritual by the Lord's Divine Human. Treated of. AC 2807:2. AC 2833. AC 2848.
It is the Lord's Divine Human which illuminates both the sight and the understanding of the spiritual...
The fear of God = worship from the good of faith, when predicated of the spiritual regenerate.
The Spiritual of the Church, or the good and truth of faith. Signified.
Behold a ram = the spiritual from the human race. AC 2833.
For by spiritual things man is introduced into celestial ones...
That the spiritual are held entangled in the Scientific Natural as to the truths of faith. Signified, Explained. AC 2832, Explained.

The spiritual have not perception of good and truth, as the celestial have, but in its place conscience, which is formed from the goods and truths of faith which they have imbibed from infancy... AC 2831:2, Explained. AC 2831:5, (Explained.)
The sanctification and adoption of the spiritual. Signified, Explained.
The quality of the state of the spiritual from the Lord's Divine Human = that they are saved who are in the faith of charity. Signified. AC 2839, Signified. AC 2848.
That the spiritual will be multiplied as the stars, and as the sand...
Seed = those of the human race who are in the faith of charity, that is, the spiritual.

The spiritual are called stars in the Word passim, because they have Knowledges and not perceptions, (and because) the spiritual have light which is relatively like the nocturnal light of the moon and stars.

Those in good within the Church are those who can be truly spiritual, because they have the Word; for man becomes spiritual through truths of doctrine conjoined with good of life: all the Spiritual is thence; but the gentiles, not having the Word, even if in the good of charity, are not truly spiritual until they have been instructed in the truths of faith.
The third class of the spiritual who are saved. Signified.

The reason truths are predicated of the spiritual, is that the spiritual are initiated into good through truths, that is, into charity through faith; and, as they do good from the affection of truth, not knowing that it is good from anything else than that they are so instructed, their conscience is founded in these truths of faith.

But with the spiritual, or in the Spiritual Church, the Intellectual is separated from the Voluntary; and the man is reformed by the Lord as to the Intellectual, and in it is formed a new will and a new understanding.
They who are being regenerated, and are becoming spiritual, are in the greatest obscurity as to truth. Good does indeed inflow with them from the Lord, but not so truth. Signified, Explained.

The spiritual are said to be bought with silver, that is, redeemed through truth. For they are regenerated, that is, introduced to good, through the truth of faith; for the spiritual man has no perception of good...

For the spiritual have nothing of the will of good, but instead of it are endowed with the faculty of understanding what good is... The spiritual, therefore, are introduced into... good through truth; but not into anything of the will of good from themselves, because the will of good with them has been lost; but into a new will, which they receive from the Lord; and, when they have received this will, they are called, in special, the redeemed.

In the regeneration of the spiritual man, he is first instructed in truths, and is then kept by the Lord in the affection of truth. The good of faith... is at the same time insinuated into him, but so that he scarcely knows it; for it lies concealed in the affection of truth. Further explained.
Natural things represent spiritual things. Explained.
Thus it is the Spiritual in the Natural which affects.
As the light of Heaven (comes) through the Divine truth in His Human, it penetrates not only to the celestial, but also to the spiritual...
Those not in good, and thence in faith... do not know that there is what is spiritual...
But the spiritual do think about the things of faith; and, when being reformed and regenerated, they are introduced into charity through them...
Spiritual things thence for natural good. Signified, Explained. (And for natural truth also. AC 3167.) AC 3168:end. AC 3171.
The internal man is the same as the spiritual man. (See Internal man, et seq.)
In Heaven there are none but spiritual things.
Seed = those who are called the spiritual. Described.
As there are (these) two classes of the spiritual they have two kinds of doctrinals - those of charity, and those of faith. Signified.
The sons of the concubines = the spiritual who are adopted by the Divine Human. These have allotments in the Spiritual Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
The spiritual are from the same father (Divine good); but not from the same mother (Divine truth) as the celestial. Explained.

(Therefore) the spiritual do not know what truth is from any perception, but call that truth which has been told them by their teachers; and therefore in them there is not the marriage of good and truth; but still the truth which they thus believe is adopted by the Lord for truth when they are in the good of life.
That the spiritual have life from the Divine Human. References.
Life is given to the spiritual through the good of faith. Treated of.
The birth of the spiritual man from the Divine influx into the affection of knowledges. Signified, Explained.
For the Spiritual has no existence except in the Rational, and therefore the spiritual man and the rational man are almost the same. Explained.
The qualities of the doctrinals of the spiritual. Signified, Explained.
The life of the Spiritual (of a Spirit) is terminated in the Natural... for man, immediately after death, cannot think spiritually, except from the things which are of his Natural.
Without doctrinals, the good of life is not yet truly spiritual...
They are called spiritual from love to the neighbour.

The reason why in the spiritual man truth dominates at first, is principally that in his first state there are delights of the love of self and of the world which he believes to be goods, and which apply themselves to his truths, and for the most part make the affection of truth with him... Intelligence and wisdom come in time; but in the meantime he is introduced through these things into good, that is, into charity; and, when he is in this, then for the first time he perceives what good is, and acts from good, and then judges and concludes about truths from this good, and calls falsities and rejects those things which do not accord with it; thus dominating over truths as a master does over his servants.

In (these verses) is described... the progress with the spiritual man when being regenerated: he first learns the doctrinals of truth; then is affected with them... afterwards, by looking into doctrinals he is affected with the truths which are in them... at last, he wills to live according to them... When he is in the good of life the order is inverted, and from this good he regards the good of truth; from this the good of doctrinals; and from this the doctrinals of truth. Thus does man, from being sensuous, become spiritual; and this is his quality when he becomes spiritual.
All spiritual things whatever can be representatively presented...
Spiritual things, which are of truth, are expressed by modifications of heavenly light... and celestial things, which are of good, by variations of heavenly flame or heat.
I will give all these lands = spiritual things... for spiritual things are nothing else than truths from the Divine.

By the Spiritual, in the genuine sense, is meant the light itself of truth which is from the Lord... and as this light inflows into both the Rational and the Natural, the Spiritual is predicated of both. AC 4675:end.
The first class of the spiritual. Treated of, Described.
The reception of truth by the spiritual. Treated of.

As the spiritual have not perception... they do not know that Divine truth becomes rational truth with man when he is regenerate. They do indeed say that all good and truth is from the Lord; yet as these come forth in their Rational they suppose them to be their own... for they cannot be separated from their proprium, which wills it to be so. Signified. AC 3394:3, Explained.
It here treats of the regenerate spiritual man, who has received the Divine good in a new will, and the Divine truth in a new understanding.
From these loves they cannot possibly see spiritual things, that is, the things which are of the light of truth from Him.
Relatively to the spiritual, the Word is not a fountain, but a well.
Unless the Spiritual from the Lord continually acted within...
The man then thinks spiritually... He then cannot think spiritually...
The pulsations of the spiritual are strong and vibratory, and are to those of the celestial as 2 to 5. (See Beat.)
Spiritual affection.
The internal sense is accommodated to the apprehension of the spiritual man.
(The spiritual man contrasted with the natural man.)
For man to become spiritual, the things of the external man must be reduced to compliance...
In these verses the regeneration of the spiritual man is treated of. (That is, the regeneration of man till he becomes spiritual. AC 3971.) AC 4402.
Joseph = the spiritual man himself. Explained. AC 3969:3. Explained.
He who is a spiritual man does not despise (riches, food, and its pleasures, etc.) Explained.
There are two things which constitute the spiritual man, namely, charity and faith... Charity from which is faith... is represented by Joseph; and faith in which is charity... by Benjamin...
The spiritual man is in the good of faith, that is, in the good from which there is truth; but before he becomes spiritual he is in the truth of faith, that is, in truth in which there is good.
The Salvation of the spiritual. Illustrated.
The acknowledgement of the Spiritual. Signified, Explained.
For the Spiritual, because it is from the Lord, is what makes the spiritual man, and the Spiritual Kingdom.
The power and disposing of the spiritual man in the natural. Signified, Explained.

Representations are the images of spiritual things in natural ones... He who does not know what the spiritual is... would say, How can what is spiritual act into what is material? Explained. AC 4053:end.
See Dura mater. SE 1692.
The Word in the Second Heaven is spiritual...
The celestial spiritual are those who above are called the spiritual...
Temptations and victories in them are what make man spiritual, (or, what make the spiritual man).
For spiritual things are founded upon natural ones, and are represented in them.
They separate spiritual life from civil... when yet no idea about spiritual life can be had except from the things which are in civil life.

Spiritual things nascent in the Natural. Signified... For in the state of infancy, when man is being regenerated, spiritual things are in potency; for spiritual life comes forth successively... as from an egg...

The spiritual man is not the interior rational man, but the interior natural man. (AC 4585:4. AC 4585:end.) ... Man becomes spiritual by this: that with him truths are conjoined with good, that is, the things of faith with the things of charity, and this in his Natural: there exterior truths are first conjoined with good, and afterwards interior truths.

The spiritual man is so called from this: that the light of Heaven inflows with him into the things which are of the light of the world, and causes the things of the former to be represented in the latter... For, regarded in itself, the Spiritual is the Divine light itself which is from the Lord, consequently, it is the intelligence of truth, and the derivative wisdom. But, with the spiritual man, this light falls into those things which are of faith with him, and which he believes to be truths...
Everything in the Word is spiritual. Explained.
Thinking spiritually. Explained.
Such are invisible where there is a spiritual sphere. Explained.
The Spiritual in its essence is nothing else (than the Divine truth which is from Him in Heaven and the Church).
Lot of those who have led a good moral life, but have caved little for spiritual things.
There are some who have imbued [the notion] that man ought not to care about... spiritual things... because interior things disturb the delights of life. (The effect of this upon them.)
See House.
At the mere mention of what is spiritual, something of darkness and sadness comes over them, and excites nausea... AC 8783:2. AC 9109:2.

When tills ultimate spiritual truth is withdrawn, the spiritual man has no longer anything with which to defend himself against the natural man. Signified, Explained. AC 5022, Explained. AC 5025, Explained. AC 5028, Explained. AC 5036:4.
For from natural light it is impossible to see the things of spiritual light...
The Spiritual with man and in the Church is compared to heaven; and the Natural to earth, because the Spiritual is prior, interior, and higher, and nearer the Divine.
That the use and the end make a thing spiritual, or not spiritual. Explained.

Temptations come forth especially when man is becoming spiritual; for he then spiritually apprehends the truths of doctrine. Explained and Treated of. AC 5036:5, Example(s). AC 5036:6. Such is the origin of spiritual anxieties.
Those of the Internal Church are spiritual... and the truly spiritual, or internal, can exist only within the Church.
The Intellectual of the spiritual man is made new and regenerated by the truth which is solely from the Lord. Signified.
From this, man has civil, moral, and spiritual life.
Under Grape, see this reference.
There is a correspondence of natural with spiritual things; and of spiritual things with celestial ones...
Man is celestial if he receives Divine good in the will; spiritual, if in the understanding.
This force, or conatus, in action, or motion, is what is spiritual in what is natural; for to think and will are spiritual, and to act and be moved are natural.
Scientifics are the ultimates of the spiritual things of the Lord's Kingdom.
How the correspondence between the Spiritual and the Natural with man is effected.
What is spiritual is at this day denied, unless thereby is meant what is interiorly natural.
(Thus) there are two things which make man spiritual, and consequently blessed (there): charity and faith.
They who have become rational men, that is, spiritual ones...
The Celestial is good from the Divine; the spiritual is truth from that good, thus it is the truth of good from His Divine Human. The Lord was this while He lived here.
The intermediate where the Spiritual is conjoined with the Natural, thus where the knees are... AC 5328.
But, with the man who is being regenerated, the spiritual becomes everything. (Continued. See Natural.)
By the spiritual is meant that in the Natural which is of the light of Heaven...

The interior things of the interior Natural are those things there which are called spiritual; and the spiritual things there are those which are from the light of Heaven... In the spiritual things there, are stored up truths adjoined to good. The spiritual things there are those which correspond to the angelic Societies in the Second Heaven...
Spiritual worship, and celestial worship.
Thus does the Natural becloud the Spiritual.
Fine flour = what is spiritual.
Spiritual things in the Natural. Signified, Explained.

What the spiritual is relatively to the Natural Explained... In its essence, the spiritual with man is the affection itself of good and truth for the sake of good and truth, and not for the sake of self; and also the affection of what is just and fair for the sake of what is just and fair, and not for the sake of self. When a man feels in himself delight... from these things, that is the Spiritual with him... This, then, is the Spiritual, which, when it reigns with a man, affects and as it were tinges everything he thinks, wills, and does, and causes his thoughts and his acts from the will to partake of what is spiritual, until at last (as after death) these also become spiritual with him. In a word, the affection of charity and faith... and the delight... thence, which are felt interiorly with the man, and cause him to be a truly Christian man, are the Spiritual.

The reason most in the Christian world are ignorant of what the Spiritual is, is that they make faith the essential of the Church, and not charity... and he who is not in the affection of charity can never know what the Spiritual is. Explained.

But... in the general sense, the Spiritual means the affection both of good and of truth. Hence Heaven is called the Spiritual World; and the internal sense... the spiritual sense; whereas, in special, that which is of the affection of good is called celestial, and that which is of the affection of truth, spiritual.
The self-humiliation of the spiritual, and of the celestial, compared.
That is called spiritual which is in the light of Heaven; for that which is in this light has in it the affection of good and the perception of truth...
The inmost of the Spiritual in the natural mind. Signified.
The spiritual, being in obscurity, put truth first. Signified, Explained. AC 6269.
That the spiritual are in obscurity. Explained.
That the spiritual man will increase more (than the celestial), Signified, Explained.

For the Voluntary of man has been continually made depraved... and, lest man should perish, the Lord has provided that he may be regenerated as to the intellectual part... Hence there are few with whom there is anything entire in the voluntary part, thus few who can become celestial men, but many who can become spiritual men.
That the Spiritual may be in the truth of the Intellectual and the good of the Voluntary. Signified, Explained.
The Celestial Church of the Spiritual. Treated of.
Extermination from the Spiritual. Signified, Explained.
That the spiritual were saved by His advent. Explained. AC 6427:2.
An archer = the spiritual man; here, one who fights with the spiritual man.
For scientifics with their delights are in the Natural, and make its life, especially with the spiritual man. Explained.

The Spiritual in its first origin is the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine Human, which truth has Divine good in it... This Divine truth, in which is Divine good, is the spiritual itself in its origin, and is the life itself which infills... the universe... In the subjects which accord with good, it presents spiritual life; but in those which are discordant with good, it presents a life contrary to spiritual life.

In this and the following verses is a still greater mystery... Those who are called the spiritual these, namely, such spiritual ones, have been saved solely by the advent of the Lord into the world. The reason is that the Divine which passes through Heaven... could not reach them, because the doctrinals of their Church were for the most part not truths, and therefore the good of their will was not good. As these could be saved solely by the advent of the Lord, they could not be any sooner elevated into Heaven, and therefore they were kept meanwhile in the Lower Earth, (where) they were much infested, yet were guarded by the Lord. But after the Lord came... and made the Human in Himself Divine, He delivered (them) and elevated them into Heaven, and of them formed the Spiritual Heaven. Signified.
(References to passages on the subject of the spiritual.)
The region to which the spiritual were elevated. (See Region.)
Where there is spiritual neediness.
These (false scientifics) chiefly infest the spiritual; for their thought is within scientifics, and but little above them.

The spiritual things which are of Heaven cannot otherwise be presented to men; for man does not apprehend naked spiritual things... and therefore spiritual things have been described by corresponding natural ones... AC 6948:4.
That instead of being a spiritual and rational man, they would become non-spiritual and non-rational. Signified, Explained.
For the acknowledgement and faith of truth, and the life of good, are the veriest Spiritual itself in the Rational; for these are from the Divine.
Elevation to a more spiritual life in the Natural. Signified, Explained. AC 7029.
Mediums of power from the Spiritual then. Signified.
That the spiritual (the sons of Israel) have not received the things announced to them. Signified.
Charity is the Spiritual itself of the Church; and is represented by Levi. AC 7506:2.
In proportion as man is in the loves of self and the world... he does not know what the Spiritual is...
For all the Spiritual is alive, because it proceeds from the Lord.
For the faith of charity makes the Spiritual of man...
These things make faith spiritual.
The Spiritual rests on the Natural. (See Natural.)
The spiritual or Christian life defined.
The natural man contrasted with the spiritual man.
The good of the spiritual man before and after regeneration. Signified, Explained.
Manna = the good of truth, which is the life of the spiritual man.
By these (natural delights) the spiritual man is introduced...
The sacrifices = spiritual things, that is, those of the truth of faith; (the burnt-offerings, celestial things).
The speech of the spiritual. Described.
